judge_model: claude-opus-4-8 (Opus 4.8, this assistant — direct vision judging)
judge_note: 判官为 Opus 4.8 本体(直接读图打分，非API/非论文原用 Gemini 3.0 Pro);单次打分，整体式每维0-5，8维几何平均，与论文聚合一致。分数仅供内部对比，不可与论文 leaderboard 直接比较。论文已证实judge在视觉主观维(element_layout ρ=0.39, visual_consistency ρ=0.47)与人工一致性低，该两维分数信度弱。
scoring: 8-dim 0-5 Likert, per-problem geometric mean; benchmark-level = arithmetic mean over problems
judging_method: single-pass, holistic per-dimension, after directly viewing all rendered scenes + original problem images + reference answers
